meta.title: Lingo - AI In-Game Chat Translation
meta.description: Lingo is an AI-powered in-game chat translation client for Windows and macOS, built around a low-interruption hotkey workflow.

hero.title: Translate. Game. Together.
hero.subtitle: Lingo is an AI-powered in-game chat translation client for Windows and macOS, built for low-friction multiplayer communication.
hero.helper: We detect your platform and highlight the best installer automatically.

mockup.title: One shortcut, one clean message
mockup.body: Select the line, trigger the hotkey, and send the translated result without tabbing out of the match.
mockup.source: Hold. Fight when my BKB is ready.
mockup.result: 别着急，等我 BKB 好了再打。
mockup.sideBody: Short sentences, stable tone, and low-friction communication for live matches.

features.title: Built for live match communication.
features.subtitle: Every section of the workflow is tuned around speed, clarity, and keeping your focus inside the game.

instant.title: Instant translate
instant.description: Trigger translation with a single shortcut and keep the current chat box focused.

server.title: Server-side AI
server.description: Translation models, routing, and updates stay on the backend so the client remains simple.

phrases.title: Quick phrases
phrases.description: Keep high-frequency callouts ready to fire without retyping the same instructions every match.

languages.title: Multilingual UI
languages.description: Ship one product experience across Chinese, English, and Russian without extra setup.

howItWorks.title: Three steps. No extra ceremony.
howItWorks.subtitle: Lingo compresses the translation loop into a repeatable sequence that fits real matches instead of interrupting them.

select.title: Select the chat text
select.description: Highlight or type the line you want inside the in-game chat box.

hotkey.title: Press your hotkey
hotkey.description: A single shortcut copies the text and sends it to the translation service.

paste.title: Paste-ready translation
paste.description: The translated result is written back for immediate sending.

download.title: Pick your platform and play.
download.subtitle: Direct installers use a Tencent Cloud mirror for faster regional downloads, with a fallback link to the full GitHub releases page.

requirements.macos: macOS 10.13+ • Apple Silicon package • DMG installer

macos.title: macOS
macos.description: Direct DMG download for the latest release.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: Direct EXE installer for the latest release.

footer.tagline: AI-powered in-game chat translation for fast team coordination.
